passage.label: No moon; night departs; morning brightens; indeed Fire greatest afflictions warning humanity whoever wills proceed stay behind; every soul earned retained except companions right gardens questioning each other criminals asking what put Saqar; say not those prayed; nor feed poor; enter vain discourse engaged; deny Day Recompense; came certainty; not benefit intercession intercessors

arabicExcerpts.text: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوۡ يَتَأَخَّرَ

mainSubject.label: Oaths by the moon, departing night and brightening morning establishing the Fire as one of the greatest afflictions and a warning to humanity for whoever chooses to proceed or stay behind; every soul retained for its earnings except the companions of the right in gardens questioning the criminals about what put them into Saqar; their confession: we did not pray, did not feed the poor, entered vain discourse and denied the Day of Recompense until certainty arrived; no intercession will benefit them

subordinateSubjects.label: And by the night when it departs
And by the morning when it brightens
The Fire named among the greatest afflictions
To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind
Every soul retained for what it earned except the companions of the right
The companions of the right in gardens
Questioning each other in the gardens
Asking what put them into Saqar
They confess: we were not of those who prayed
Nor did we feed the poor
We entered vain discourse with those engaged in it
We denied the Day of Recompense
No intercession of any intercessors will benefit them

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Criminals confessing four failures: prayer neglect, poor-feeding neglect, vain discourse and denial of the Day
Certainty arriving too late for intercession to benefit

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Neglect of feeding the poor listed alongside prayer abandonment as grounds for Saqar

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the difficult-Day declaration for disbelievers (10) before the Walid-profile and Saqar block opens (11); P2 ends with the Fire-as-humanity-reminder statement (31) before the moon-night-morning oaths begin (32); P3 runs through the oath triad, the criminal-confession dialogue and the intercession-nullification (32-48); P4 covers the donkey simile, scripture-demand exposure, Quran-as-reminder and closing divine-will affirmation (49-56).
